listed_sector_signals.signal: Passing mention of cement, glass and paper industries as major energy-intensive industrial consumers alongside the chemical industry
listed_sector_signals.quote:
It is therefore a major industrial consumer 
along with the cement, glass, paper and 
engineering industries.

one_line: A consultancy opinion/method article describing "Leanergy", a lean-manufacturing-based approach to improve energy efficiency in energy-intensive (mainly chemical) industry; cement, glass and paper are named only in passing and no specific continuous-flow production is empirically demonstrated.
